# zurds

zurds inspects and safely reads the files R writes with
[`saveRDS()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/readRDS.html),
[`save()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/save.html) and
[`serialize()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/serialize.html), without handing
them to R’s deserializer. It is in early development; see the
[roadmap](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/.agents/roadmap.md).

## Installation

You can install the development version of zurds from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("pedrobtz/zurds")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(zurds)
## basic example code
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`rds_deps()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_deps.md)
  : Packages a file needs
- [`rds_extract()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_extract.md)
  : Extract one object or element from an R serialization file
- [`rds_info()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_info.md)
  : Header of an R serialization file
- [`rds_read_data()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_read_data.md)
  : Read a data-only R serialization file safely
- [`rds_scan()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_scan.md)
  [`rds_is_safe()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_scan.md)
  : Scan an R serialization file for code and references
- [`rds_str()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_str.md) :
  Structure of an R serialization file
- [`rds_toc()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_toc.md) :
  Table of contents of an .rda file
- [`zurds-conditions`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/zurds-conditions.md)
  : Conditions raised by zurds
- [`zurds_info()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/zurds_info.md)
  : Build information
